headings: Need a Pass Now? Monthly MBTA Options
text:
## General Transportation Announcements
- UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities .

## MBTA
Conveniently located just a mile from JFK/UMass Station, UMass Boston is easily accessible by public transportation. The campus is served by the Red Line, as well as the Greenbush , Kingston , and Middleborough/Lakeville commuter rail lines. Additionally, Route 8 operates daily from Kenmore Square, and Route 16 is available during peak commuting hours from Forest Hills.

## CLOSED | Spring 2026 Semester Pass Information
Spring Semester pass sales ended January 9, 2026. If you purchased a pass, find pickup and validity information below. If you missed the deadline, see "Need a Pass Now?" section below. Distribution Method: Spring 2026 MBTA Semester Passes will be available for pickup on campus beginning Monday, January 26. Students will receive an email with pickup instructions the week of January 19. Pass Validity Period: Spring MBTA semester passes are valid from February 1 to May 31, 2026. Plan Your Commute: Plan your commute using the MBTA Trip Planner . Pricing Information: View MBTA Semester Pass Pricing Information . Link and Bus Passes: Link, Local, and Express bus passes are issued via CharlieCards once per semester. Link and bus passes can be replaced if lost. Zone and Boat Passes: Zone and Boat passes are issued monthly on CharlieTickets. All passes are included in the total semester pass cost. Zone and Boat passes cannot be replaced. Refund Policy : MBTA passes are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, so make your purchase decision carefully. Payment Process: The semester pass cost will be added automatically to your Spring term bill. Cash, personal checks, or debit/credit cards are not accepted. Liability: The university is not liable for lost or damaged passes and cannot replace commuter rail or boat passes. Subsidy for Undergraduate Students: A $20 nonrefundable fee on undergraduate term bills provides discounts for eligible undergraduate students. STATUS (as of December 26, 2025): The 50% subsidy was fully allocated. Undergraduate students purchasing later in the sales window received an 11% discount. For subsidy inquiries, contact studentgovernment @umb.edu .

## Need a Pass Now? Monthly MBTA Options
If you did not purchase a Spring 2026 MBTA Semester Pass through UMass Boston, you can still access MBTA service by purchasing a monthly pass directly from the MBTA. Monthly passes purchased directly from the MBTA: Are not eligible for the UMass Boston student subsidy Are not part of the MBTA semester pass program Must be purchased and managed through the MBTA’s own systems Purchasing Options: Purchase a Bus or Subway monthly pass Purchase a Commuter Rail or Boat monthly pass Students who purchase monthly passes directly from the MBTA will pay MBTA’s standard prices without UMass Boston subsidy or discount.
If you did not purchase a Spring 2026 MBTA Semester Pass through UMass Boston, you can still access MBTA service by purchasing a monthly pass directly from the MBTA.
Monthly passes purchased directly from the MBTA:
- Are not eligible for the UMass Boston student subsidy
- Are not part of the MBTA semester pass program
- Must be purchased and managed through the MBTA’s own systems
Purchasing Options:
- Purchase a Bus or Subway monthly pass
- Purchase a Commuter Rail or Boat monthly pass
Students who purchase monthly passes directly from the MBTA will pay MBTA’s standard prices without UMass Boston subsidy or discount.

## MBTA Pass Replacement Information
Lost or stolen Semester Link or Bus pass? Request a complimentary replacement using our online form . Eligibility for Replacement : Replacement approval is available only for Link or Bus passes purchased through the university's semester pass program. Non-Refundable and Non-Replaceable Passes : MBTA Commuter Rail and Boat passes, including Zone 1A, are nonrefundable and nonreplaceable if lost or stolen, even if lost during mail transit.

## Employee Transportation Benefits
Through the Qualified Transportation Benefits Program (QTBP), faculty and staff are eligible for a pre-tax benefit program that includes public transit expenses. Please visit Human Resources for further information and contact hr@umb.edu with any questions.

## Park & Pedal Facilities
Register your CharlieCard semester pass or obtain a blank CharlieCard at our office to access Park & Pedal facilities. CharlieCard registration is required for free bike parking at all locations. Register your CharlieCard by following this link . Visit the MBTA's bike parking webpage for facility locations, policies, and rules.
